  {"step":2,"file":"lib/odp-util.c","function":"parse_odp_push_nsh_action","line":2036,"var":"nsh","code":"ovs_scan_len(s, &n, \"push_nsh(\")","note":"The parser recognizes a push_nsh action and begins filling an NSH key structure from the input."},
  {"step":3,"file":"lib/odp-util.c","function":"parse_odp_push_nsh_action","line":2044,"var":"nsh.mdtype","code":"nsh.mdtype = NSH_M_TYPE1;","note":"The default metadata type is initialized before optional fields are parsed."},
  {"step":4,"file":"lib/odp-util.c","function":"parse_odp_push_nsh_action","line":2070,"var":"metadata","code":"ovs_scan_len(s, &n, \"md2=0x%511[0-9a-fA-F]\", buf)","note":"For MD type 2, the parser copies attacker-supplied hex metadata into a local buffer and computes md_size from it."},
  {"step":5,"file":"lib/odp-util.c","function":"parse_odp_push_nsh_action","line":2129,"var":"actions","code":"nsh_key_to_attr(actions, &nsh, metadata, md_size, false);","note":"The parsed NSH fields and metadata are serialized into a nested netlink action attribute."},
  {"step":6,"file":"lib/odp-util.c","function":"nsh_key_to_attr","line":2001,"var":"metadata","code":"if (nsh->mdtype == NSH_M_TYPE2) { if (metadata && md_size > 0) nl_msg_put_unspec(buf, OVS_NSH_KEY_ATTR_MD2, metadata, md_size); }","note":"The serializer forwards the attacker-controlled metadata pointer and length into nl_msg_put_unspec for the MD2 attribute."},
  {"step":7,"file":"lib/netlink.c","function":"nl_msg_put_unspec","line":244,"var":"data","code":"ptr = nl_msg_put_unspec_uninit(msg, type, size); nullable_memcpy(ptr, data, size);","note":"The helper copies the attribute payload with nullable_memcpy, which is the sink named in the crash report."},
  {"step":8,"file":"lib/util.h","function":"nullable_memcpy","line":170,"var":"src","code":"if (n) { memcpy(dst, src, n); }","note":"The copy dereferences the supplied source buffer when size is non-zero, completing the vulnerable read path."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p)
